title: Textile Operations Lead (Production, Merchandising & Quality)
description:
Job Overview

Anuprerna Artisan Alliance is seeking an experienced, proactive **Textile Production & Merchandising Manager** to lead end-to-end textile operations, quality assurance, and artisan cluster management.

In this pivotal operational role, you will bridge client requirements and on-ground production. You will be responsible for translating design and client orders into structured production plans, managing Time & Action (T&A) calendars, overseeing raw material procurement and dyeing/weaving processes, enforcing strict quality standards, and directly leading field supervisors and artisan teams.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge of yarns, natural fibers, weave structures, and finishing, paired with hands-on commercial merchandising acumen and the leadership ability to ensure on-time, defect-free delivery.

Key Responsibilities. Production Planning & Cluster Execution

* Develop, monitor, and execute comprehensive Time & Action (T&A) production calendars across all running orders to ensure 100% on-time delivery.
* Plan loom capacities, manage yarn consumption matrices, and allocate production runs across internal units, weaver clusters, and external dyeing facilities.
* Track work-in-progress (WIP) from raw yarn procurement, warping, and dyeing through weaving, washing, finishing, and packing.
* Proactively identify production bottlenecks, material shortages, or weather-dependent delays, implementing rapid corrective actions.

2. Textile Merchandising & Costing

* Coordinate order specifications, approvals, and buyer requirements from initial sampling through bulk dispatch.
* Prepare accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cost breakdowns, fabric yields, and consumption estimates for custom developments and commercial collections.
* Manage sampling cycles, lab dips, strike-offs, and counter-samples, obtaining formal sign-offs before bulk production rollout.
* Serve as the technical link between internal management/sales and field execution teams.

3. Quality Assurance & Technical Control (QA/QC)

* Establish and implement standardized inspection protocols across raw materials (yarn count, strength, twist), in-line weaving, and final fabric finishing.
* Supervise physical testing parameters including GSM, dimensional stability (shrinkage), colorfastness, rub fastness, and weaving defect tolerances (utilizing 4-Point System or relevant international standards).
* Audit dyeing units (natural and azo-free certified processes) to ensure batch-to-batch shade consistency and lot integrity.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on defects and implement preventive measures to systematically drive down rejections.

4. Team Leadership & Artisan Management

* Direct and mentor on-site supervisors, quality checkers, logistics staff, and weaver cluster coordinators.
* Foster fair, professional, and productive relationships with artisan networks, weavers, and dyeing partners.
* Maintain clean production ERP records, inventory audits, and regular status reports for executive management.

Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Textile Design, or Apparel Production (e.g., GCETT, NIFT, or recognized textile institutes).
* **Experience:** 4 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in textile production, merchandising, or quality assurance within textile mills, handloom/powerloom clusters, export houses, or sustainable textile enterprises.
* **Technical Mastery:** In-depth knowledge of fiber classifications, yarn counts, weave constructions (plain, twill, dobby, jacquard), GSM analysis, dyeing mechanics, and post-loom finishing treatments.
* **Process Knowledge:** Familiarity with handloom, artisanal textile techniques, natural fibers (silk, linen, cotton), and eco-conscious or sustainable finishing standards is strongly preferred.
* **Operational Skills:** High proficiency in creating and managing T&A schedules, fabric costing, and inventory tracking using MS Excel / Google Sheets or textile ERP tools.
* **Languages & Leadership:** Strong cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to communicate effectively with artisans and local weavers in Bengali, along with professional working proficiency in English or Hindi for reporting.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Please mention your educational background in Textile Engineering / Textile Technology or related field.
* What practical experience do you have in textile production, weaving, dyeing, yarn handling, or fabric manufacturing? Please explain briefly.
* Do you have technical knowledge of yarn count, GSM, fabric structures, dyeing, weaving, or natural textile processes? Please mention the areas you are familiar with.
* Are you comfortable working from our office location in Debipur, Memari, Purba Bardhaman?
* Are you comfortable with the salary range of INR 20,000 – 25,000? If not, please mention your current remuneration.

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager – Fasteners (Nut & Bolt Manufacturing)
description:
**Job Title:** Production Manager – Fasteners  
**Industry:** Fasteners / Engineering Manufacturing  
**Location:** Gabberia, Ranihati, Howrah  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 5–7 Years  
**Department:** Production  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering preferred

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Production Manager** to manage and control the complete production operations of our **Fasteners Manufacturing Plant**, primarily involving **Nuts, Bolts, Screws, Washers and related engineering components**.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in **fastener manufacturing, production planning, shop-floor management, manpower handling, quality coordination and productivity improvement**.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Plan, organize and monitor daily, weekly and monthly production activities.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within the planned time, cost and quality parameters.
* Manage complete production processes for **Nut, Bolt, Screw, Washer and other fasteners**.
* Prepare production plans based on customer orders, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Monitor production processes such as **forging, heading, thread rolling, tapping, machining and related operations**.
* Ensure optimum utilization of machines, manpower, raw materials and other production resources.
* Monitor machine productivity, production efficiency, rejection and downtime.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve production output.
* Coordinate with **Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Purchase and Dispatch** departments for smooth production operations.
* Ensure proper adherence to approved process parameters, drawings and quality standards.
* Reduce rejection, rework, material wastage and production losses.
* Monitor manpower deployment and ensure effective utilization of workers and supervisors.
* Lead and guide Production Supervisors, Foremen and shop-floor workers.
* Maintain and review daily production reports, downtime reports, rejection reports and productivity reports.
* Ensure proper implementation of **5S, safety practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs)** on the shop floor.
* Conduct regular production meetings and review target vs. actual performance.
* Support continuous improvement and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure timely completion of production as per customer delivery schedules.
* Take responsibility for overall production discipline and shop-floor efficiency.

***Required Experience:***

* **5–7 years of relevant experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the **Fasteners / Nut & Bolt industry**.
* Strong hands-on experience in **cold forging / hot forging, thread rolling, tapping, machining and fastener production processes** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling a complete production team in a manufacturing plant.
* Good knowledge of production planning, capacity utilization and productivity monitoring.
* Experience in reducing rejection, downtime and production wastage.
* Candidates from **Nut, Bolt, Screw, Washer or Engineering Component Manufacturing** industries are preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong Production Planning & Execution
* Fastener Manufacturing Process Knowledge
* Shop-Floor Management
* Manpower Management
* Machine & Capacity Planning
* Productivity Improvement
* Rejection & Wastage Control
* Production MIS & Reporting
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Leadership & Team Management
* Basic knowledge of ERP/SAP will be an advantage

Education

**Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. – Mechanical Engineering** preferred.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and suitability
* Leadership role with responsibility for production operations
* Opportunity to work with an established fastener manufacturing organization
* Growth opportunity based on performance

**Interested candidates may apply with their updated CV. Candidates with strong hands-on experience in fastener manufacturing will be given preference.**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Howrah, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* What is your expected CTC?
* Do you have experience in fateners industry? (Mandatory)
* What is your current CTC?

Work Location: In person

title: Property Operations Executive – Housekeeping & Guest Management
description:
**About the Role**

Renteel is seeking an energetic, detail\-oriented **Property Operations Executive** to oversee on\-ground property management across our Short\-Term Rentals (STRs) and Paying Guest (PG) units.

In this role, you will be the single point of contact for daily operations—ensuring top\-tier cleanliness, smooth guest check\-ins/check\-outs, and rapid resolution of property issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Guest Handling \& Check\-Ins:** Coordinate guest arrivals, conduct smooth check\-ins and key handovers, handle identity verifications, and serve as the direct contact for guest requests during their stay.
* **Housekeeping \& Cleanliness Standards:** Directly supervise or execute property turnover between bookings, ensuring linen changes, deep cleaning, and hotel\-grade presentation.
* **Inventory \& Supplies:** Monitor and restock guest amenities, cleaning supplies, and essential toiletries across all managed properties.
* **Maintenance Coordination:** Inspect units regularly for electrical, plumbing, or appliance issues and coordinate swift repairs with local technicians.
* **PG Facility Management:** Ensure regular upkeep of common areas, timely utility checks, and enforce house rules for long\-term PG residents.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1 to 2 years in hospitality operations, boutique guest houses, short\-term rentals, or PG management.
* **Ownership Mindset:** Ability to work independently and manage property turnovers without constant supervision.
* **Communication**: Courteous and professional interpersonal skills in local language and basic English/Hindi for guest handling.
* **Mobility:** Must have a valid two\-wheeler and driving license for local site\-to\-site travel.
* **Availability:** Flexible schedule, including weekends and public holidays when check\-ins are peak.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
